skills.description: ego-browser (ego-lite) is a Chromium-based browser designed from the ground up to be friendly to both human users and AI Agents. AI Agents work in their own isolated space, reusing the user's login state without competing for the browser. Use this skill whenever the user needs to interact with a website opening pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting page data, testing web apps, logging into sites, automating browser operations, or any other browser automation task.
